text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки seizes victory in the
Takamatsunomiya
Kinen and her fans'
expectations for her climb
ever higher.

But her behavior seems off ever since
that day.
She seems constantly
distracted and distant...

The amount of attention Фудзи Кисэки is
getting
from the world is reaching the
point of becoming
a social phenomenon.
Next up is the Yasuda
Kinen, a mile-long
race that's right up her alley.
